utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Ira, what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the full list yet, but I can check around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that would help. Can you ask around and let me know what you find?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help with the repair drive — I can lend a few tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus — that’d really help. I’m trying to keep track of everything, but I might miss a few things, so I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course — I’ve got a hammer, screwdriver set, and a wrench you can borrow. Just let me know what else you need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout — folks are bringing tools, parts, and plenty of goodwill.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear — I’m just hoping we’ve got enough space and a clear drop-off plan so nothing gets tangled up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think so — they’re setting up a marked drop-off table by the hall entrance, and someone’s bringing extra bins for sorting. If it gets busy, we can always point folks to the side path so it stays orderly.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you check the donation box by the community center and bring it to my porch on Maple Street?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check the donation box by the community center and bring it over to your porch on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now—want me to add you to the invite list?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. Yes, please add me to the invite list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll put you on the list and send the details soon!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m putting the repair drive details in order now. If you’ve got any requests or ideas, send them my way and I’ll make sure they’re included.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — please add a note asking for tool donations and a list of the most needed repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll add a note for tool donations and include the most needed repairs list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the details of the repair drive first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — what details do you need first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Please start with the date, time, and location, and then I’ll ask anything else I need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—just let me know when the repair drive is happening and what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s so helpful, Faye — thank you. I’m still locking in the date, but I’ll send you the details and what we need as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — just send it over when it’s set, and I’ll work around it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely—people are signing up, and we’ve got a few folks already pitching in. I’m trying to connect the different groups so we can fill the last gaps.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great to hear — I’ve just been catching snippets, so I’m glad it’s moving along. If you hear where they still need help, let me know and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the repair drive details and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what details you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just the time, place, and what needs fixing — keep it brief and I’ll skim it fast.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad the repair drive is happening. If you need a hand, I can help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s really kind of you, Rey. I might take you up on that once I remember where I put the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — just let me know when you find them, and I’ll come by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and keep people posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — that would help a lot. I’ll keep track of the supplies, and you can handle the updates.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll let folks know what’s needed and keep them posted as things come together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, just remind me what’s needed and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren—just bring any extra tools, tape, or small repair supplies to my porch, and I’ll sort them for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—I’ll swing by with whatever I’ve got and leave it on your porch. Thanks for organizing it, Vik.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details; what time is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It starts at 10 a.m. over by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, 10 a.m. by the community center — I’ll try to be there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I can lend a hand or some tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple—I'll make a list of what’s needed, and then we can go from there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — send me the list when you’re ready, and I’ll see what I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive — what’s the next thing you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Mara — could you put out the word to a few neighbors and let them know we’re gathering tools and volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll reach out to a few neighbors and let them know we’re collecting tools and volunteers. If you want, I can also mention any specific items you still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help link folks up for the repair drive—just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules—could you note that I’m in the little house on Maple near the corner store? I’d like to be matched with a furniture repair volunteer.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ve got you down at the little house on Maple by the corner store, and I’ll look for a furniture repair volunteer for you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’ve got the repair drive notes ready, and I’m happy to coordinate whatever you need next.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — I can gather the supplies list and check what we already have. Just tell me what’s still needed, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll send over the missing items list, and we can divide up anything still to gather. Thanks for keeping track, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m a bit out of the loop—has the repair drive started yet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet, but it should start later today. Do you want me to let you know when it kicks off?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes please, that’d be great. I’d really appreciate a heads-up when it starts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help by dropping off the repair items after school? I can sort the list, but I need someone to take them over.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can drop them off after school. Just send me the list and where to take them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Could you confirm what kind of help you mean—sorting donations or lifting boxes?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with both, but I’m best at sorting donations and I can lift boxes too if needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming up soon, but I’m still a bit fuzzy on the details. Do you know what they need help with?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not fully up to speed either, but I can check and let you know. I’m usually late to these things, but I’ll find out what they need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Dane — I’d appreciate that. I’m happy to help once I know what they’re looking for.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara. We still need to check which houses need pickups and make a quick list of the repair spots.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can do the pickup check and start the list. Want me to cover the east side first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on supplies for the repair drive. Tell me what you still need, and I’ll check what we have.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure, can you confirm what supplies we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check, but I don’t have the list in front of me yet. If you tell me the categories, I’ll help sort out what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m sharing the word about the repair drive, and I’d love for you to come by if you can. Want me to tell you the time and place?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, please — tell me the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s this Saturday at 10 a.m. over at the community center. I’d love to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help out—what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s kind of you, Leo. I’m just trying to figure out the list and timing first so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—send me the list and timing when you have them, and I’ll fit what I can in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to connect or coordinate?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — can you double-check the repair drive list and confirm which items still need volunteers? If there’s anything missing, let me know before we share it out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll double-check the list and flag any items that still need volunteers or anything missing before you share it out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Rey — I’m organizing the repair drive now, and I can use a hand with tracking supplies and neighbors’ requests.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course, Rosa — I can help keep track of supplies and requests. Just tell me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — could you start by listing the supplies we already have, then note any neighbors’ requests that come in? I’ll keep the drive organized from here.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely—people are signing up and bringing tools already. If you want, I can pass along the latest details as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I’d appreciate that—just let me know if there’s anything I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do—right now, it sounds like extra gloves and a cordless drill would be especially handy. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Eli, are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, we’re still on for today. I’ll be there after breakfast, same place and time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, see you there after breakfast.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what’s the repair drive asking for?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Mostly tools, spare parts, and any small appliances folks don’t need anymore. I can help sort through donations if you want.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can drop off a few tools and an old toaster. I’ll swing by when I can and help sort a bit too.
